async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the 'Madison Island' link to go to the homepage
    home_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Madison Island", exact=True)
    await home_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Wait for homepage to load
    # Navigate to the admin page using relative URL
    await page.goto('/admin')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Wait for admin page to load
    # Check if we are on admin login or dashboard; look for reports link
    reports_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Reports', exact=False)
    if await reports_link.count() > 0:
        await reports_link.first.click()
    else:
        # If no reports link, try to find sales or orders in navigation
        sales_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Sales', exact=False)
        if await sales_link.count() > 0:
            await sales_link.first.click()
        else:
            # Fallback: navigate to reports page directly
            await page.goto('/admin/reports/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    # Now, on reports page, set date range for Jan to Nov 2022
    start_date = page.get_by_role('textbox').filter(has_text='From')
    if await start_date.count() > 0:
        await start_date.first.fill('01/01/2022')
    else:
        textboxes = page.get_by_role('textbox').all()
        for tb in textboxes:
            placeholder = await tb.get_attribute('placeholder')
            if placeholder and 'from' in placeholder.lower():
                await tb.fill('01/01/2022')
                break
    end_date = page.get_by_role('textbox').filter(has_text='To')
    if await end_date.count() > 0:
        await end_date.first.fill('11/30/2022')
    else:
        textboxes = page.get_by_role('textbox').all()
        for tb in textboxes:
            placeholder = await tb.get_attribute('placeholder')
            if placeholder and 'to' in placeholder.lower():
                await tb.fill('11/30/2022')
                break
    # Filter for successful orders (status 'Complete')
    status_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox').filter(has_text='Status')
    if await status_combobox.count() > 0:
        await status_combobox.first.select_option(label='Complete')
    else:
        comboboxes = page.get_by_role('combobox').all()
        for cb in comboboxes:
            options = cb.get_by_role('option').all()
            for opt in options:
                text = await opt.text_content()
                if 'Complete' in text:
                    await cb.select_option(label='Complete')
                    break
    # Apply filters
    apply_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Apply', exact=False)
    if await apply_button.count() == 0:
        apply_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search', exact=False)
    if await apply_button.count() > 0:
        await apply_button.first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    # Extract monthly counts from report table
    tables = page.get_by_role('table').all()
    monthly_counts = []
    for table in tables:
        rows = table.get_by_role('row').all()
        for row in rows:
            cells = row.get_by_role('cell').all()
            if len(cells) >= 2:
                month = await cells[0].text_content()
                count = await cells[1].text_content()
                if month.strip() and count.strip():
                    monthly_counts.append(f'{month.strip()}:{count.strip()}')
    # Print result as comma-separated MM:COUNT pairs
    result = ','.join(monthly_counts)
    print(result)
    return result

first_link = page.get_by_role("article", name="Willy Wonka").get_by_role("link", name="Share")

</example>

article {{

        websites: Website to apply the rule to (default: "Main Website").
        customer_groups: Customer group to apply the rule to (default: "General").
        coupon: Coupon type, 'No Coupon' or 'Specific Coupon' (default: "No Coupon").
        public_in_rss_feed: Whether to publicize in RSS feed, 'Yes' or 'No' (default: "Yes").
        discount_type: Type of discount to apply (default: "Percent of product price discount").
        discount_amount: Amount of discount (e.g., "10" for 10%) (default: "10").
